About us

Grooming with gentle hands and a happy heart

Spooky Dog Cat Grooming Parlour is a dedicated pet grooming parlour in Ghaziabad for both dogs and cats. Every pet is handled patiently and gently — no rushing, no stress, just careful grooming from start to finish.

From a quick bath to a full grooming session, we take the time your pet needs to look great and feel comfortable.
